title: Solo Leveling UI for Minecraft PE (Anime Menu Pack)
topic: Solo Leveling se inspired anime UI pack ke saath Minecraft PE/Bedrock ke interface ko themed look dene wala short showcase.
description: Solo Leveling se inspired anime UI pack ke saath Minecraft PE/Bedrock ke interface ko themed look dene wala short showcase. Video mein Sung Jin-woo-inspired visuals, custom main menu, loading screens, health bars/HUD aur anime-style buttons dikhaye gaye hain. Pack ka purpose interface ko customise karna hai; title ka “Monarch” theme creative flavour hai, gameplay power-up ka claim nahi.
